CREATE INDEX papa_room_kind ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (kind, ((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)))
CREATE INDEX papa_room_player ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), ((data ->> 'playerId'::text)))
CREATE INDEX papa_room_song ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), ((data ->> 'songId'::text)))
CREATE INDEX papa_room_status ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), ((data ->> 'status'::text)))
CREATE INDEX papa_room_time ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), ((data ->> 'at'::text)))
CREATE INDEX papa_song_search_source_trgm ON public.papa_v2_entities USING gin (papa_song_search_source(data) gin_trgm_ops) WHERE (kind = 'songs'::text)

CREATE INDEX papa_queue_preparation_due ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (((data ->> 'preparationEndsAt'::text))) WHERE ((kind = 'queue'::text) AND ((data ->> 'status'::text) = 'waiting'::text) AND ((data ->> 'preparationEndsAt'::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE((data ->> 'readyAt'::text), ''::text) = ''::text))
CREATE INDEX papa_entity_space_kind ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (space_id, kind, id) WHERE (space_id IS NOT NULL)

CREATE INDEX papa_entity_room_read ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (space_id, kind, ((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), id) WHERE (kind = ANY (ARRAY['songs'::text, 'ledger'::text, 'queue'::text, 'crowns'::text, 'cards'::text, 'wishes'::text]))

CREATE INDEX papa_completed_player_room ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (space_id, ((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), ((data ->> 'playerId'::text))) WHERE ((kind = 'queue'::text) AND ((data ->> 'status'::text) = 'completed'::text))
CREATE INDEX papa_accounting_source ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (space_id, ((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), ((data ->> 'source_transaction_id'::text))) WHERE (kind = 'queue'::text)
CREATE INDEX papa_accounting_queue_settlement ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (space_id, ((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), ((data ->> 'queueId'::text))) WHERE (kind = 'ledger'::text)

CREATE INDEX papa_queue_room_kind_status ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (space_id, ((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text)), ((data ->> 'kind'::text)), ((data ->> 'status'::text))) WHERE (kind = 'queue'::text)

CREATE INDEX papa_queue_own_active ON public.papa_v2_entities USING btree (space_id, ((data ->> 'playerId'::text)), ((data ->> 'streamer_id'::text))) WHERE ((kind = 'queue'::text) AND ((data ->> 'status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'waiting'::text])))
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER papa_accounting_fact_guard BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.papa_v2_entities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION papa_accounting_preserve_fact()

CREATE TRIGGER papa_entity_space_guard_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.papa_v2_entities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION papa_entity_space_guard()

CREATE TRIGGER papa_legacy_streamer_space_map_trigger AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF data ON public.papa_v2_entities FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.kind = 'meta'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION papa_legacy_streamer_space_map()
CREATE TRIGGER papa_player_device_revoke_trigger AFTER UPDATE OF data ON public.papa_v2_entities FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.kind = 'players'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION papa_player_device_revoke()

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = ANY (ARRAY['players'::text, 'settings'::text, 'meta'::text])) AND (space_id IS NULL)) OR ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['songs'::text, 'ledger'::text, 'queue'::text, 'crowns'::text, 'cards'::text, 'wishes'::text])) AND (space_id IS NOT NULL))))
